description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 0 to 7 with a linear scale, while the y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 12 to 28, also on a linear scale. The Consistency-CE model, represented by a purple dotted line with circular markers, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 12.8 at AL = 0 and increases to about 25.5 at AL = 7. The Inconsistency-CE model, shown as a dark purple dashed line with square markers, begins at a BLEU score of approximately 20.1 at AL = 0 and rises to about 26.5 at AL = 7. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model, depicted by a blue dashed line with square markers, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 19.8 at AL = 0 and increases to about 26.8 at AL = 7. The Consistency-Bi model, represented by a red solid line with star markers, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 22.5 at AL = 0 and increases to about 27.5 at AL = 7. All four models show a general upward trend in BLEU score as average lagging increases.
